title: 11 July 1963: Live: Winter Gardens, Margate
content:
The Beatles performed at Margate’s Winter Gardens on six consecutive nights, playing to two different ‘houses’ each time. 11 July 1963 was the fourth day.

They performed the same nine-song set each time: ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘Thank You Girl’, ‘Chains’, ‘Please Please Me’, ‘A Taste Of Honey’, ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘Baby It’s You’, ‘From Me To You’, and ‘Twist And Shout’.
